verses.text: Paul, apostle—no from men, and no through man, but through Jesus Christ, and Papa God, wey raise am from di dead—
and all di brothers wey dey with me, to di assemblies of Galatia:
Grace to una and peace from Papa God, and our Lord Jesus Christ,
wey give imself for our sins, so that e go deliver us from this present evil age, according to di will of our God and Papa;
to whom make glory dey forever and ever. Amen.
I marvel say una dey leave am wey call una for di grace of Christ so quick go different “Good News”;
and no other “Good News” dey. Only some people dey trouble una, and want pervert di Good News of Christ.
But even if we, or angel from heaven, preach to una any “Good News” wey no be di one wey we preach to una, make dem curse am.
As we don talk before, so I dey talk again now: If any man preach to una any “Good News” wey no be di one wey una receive, make dem curse am.
Because I dey seek di favor of men now, or of God? Or I dey try please men? Because if I still dey please men, I no go be servant of Christ.
But I dey make known to una, brothers, about di Good News wey I preach, say e no be according to man.
Because I no receive am from man, and dem no teach me am, but e come to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
Because una don hear about my way of living for time past for di Jews religion, how beyond measure I persecute di assembly of God, and destroy am.
I advance for di Jews religion pass many of my own age among my countrymen, as I dey zealous well well for di traditions of my papa dem.
But when e please God, wey separate me, even from my mama womb, and call me through im grace,
to reveal im Pikin inside me, so that I go preach am among di Gentiles, I no consult flesh and blood at once,
and I no go up to Jerusalem to di people wey be apostles before me. But I go Arabia, and again I return to Damascus.
Den after three years I go up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stay with am 15 days.
But of di other apostles I no see anybody except James, di Lord brother.
Now about di things wey I write to una, look, before God, I no dey lie.
Den I come enter di regions of Syria and Cilicia.
I still dey unknown by face to di assemblies of Judea wey dey Christ,
but dem only hear: “Di one wey persecute us before dey preach di faith now wey e destroy before.”
And dem praise God because of me.
Den after 14 years I go up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, dey take Titus with me too.
I go up by revelation, and I lay before dem di Good News wey I dey preach among di Gentiles, but privately before di people wey dem respect, because I fear say I dey run, or don run, for nothing.
But even Titus wey dey with me, as e be Greek, dem no force am to circumcise.
This was because of di false brothers wey dem bring in secretly, wey enter quietly to spy on our freedom wey we get for Christ Jesus, so that dem go bring us into bondage;
to whom we no give place for subjection, no even for one hour, so that di truth of di Good News go continue with una.
But from di people wey dem consider important—whatever dem be, e no make any difference to me; God no dey show partiality to man—dem, I talk, wey dem respect, no add anything to me,
but on di contrary, when dem see say dem don trust me with di Good News for di uncircumcision, even as Peter with di Good News for di circumcision
—because di one wey work through Peter for di apostleship of di circumcision work through me for di Gentiles too—

and when dem perceive di grace wey dem give me, James and Cephas and John, wey dem consider pillars, give me and Barnabas di right hand of fellowship, say we go go to di Gentiles, and dem to di circumcision.
Dem only ask us to remember di poor—wey be di very thing wey I dey zealous to do too.
But when Peter come Antioch, I resist am to im face, because e dey condemned.
Because before some people come from James, e dey chop with di Gentiles. But when dem come, e draw back and separate imself, as e fear di people wey dey of di circumcision.
And di rest of di Jews join am for im hypocrisy; so that even Barnabas follow dem hypocrisy go.

But when I see say dem no dey waka straight according to di truth of di Good News, I talk to Peter before dem all, “If you, as Jew, dey live like di Gentiles dey live, and no like di Jews dey live, why you dey force di Gentiles to live like di Jews?
We, wey be Jews by nature, and no be Gentile sinners,

yet we know say man no dey justified by di works of di law but through faith for Jesus Christ, even we believe for Christ Jesus, so that dem go justify us by faith for Christ, and no by di works of di law; because by di works of di law, no flesh go dey justified.
But if, while we dey seek to dey justified for Christ, dem find us sinners too, Christ na servant of sin? Never!
Because if I build up again those things wey I destroy, I prove myself law-breaker.
Because I, through di law, die to di law, so that I go live to God.

Dem don crucify me with Christ, and no be me dey live again, but Christ dey live inside me. Di life wey I dey live now for di flesh, I dey live am by faith for God Pikin, wey love me, and give imself up for me.
I no reject di grace of God. Because if righteousness dey through di law, den Christ die for nothing!”
Foolish Galatians, who don bewitch una say una no go obey di truth, una wey dem openly portray Jesus Christ among una as crucified?
I just want learn this from una. Una receive di Spirit by di works of di law, or by hearing of faith?
Una foolish like that? As una don begin for di Spirit, una dey complete now for di flesh?
Una suffer so many things for nothing, if e truly dey for nothing?
So di one wey dey supply una di Spirit, and dey work miracles among una, e dey do am by di works of di law, or by hearing of faith?
Na so, “Abraham believe God, and dem count am to am for righteousness.”
So know say di people wey dey of faith, na dem be Abraham pikin dem.
Di Scripture, as e see before say God go justify di Gentiles by faith, preach di Good News before to Abraham, dey talk say, “For you all di nations go dey blessed.”
So di people wey dey of faith dey blessed with faithful Abraham.
Because as many as dey of di works of di law dey under curse. Because e dey write, “Cursed be everybody wey no continue for all things wey dem write for di book of di law, to do dem.”
Now say no man dey justified by di law before God clear, because, “Di righteous go live by faith.”
Di law no dey of faith, but, “Di man wey do dem go live by dem.”
Christ redeem us from di curse of di law, as e become curse for us. Because e dey write, “Cursed be everybody wey hang for tree,”
so that di blessing of Abraham go come on di Gentiles through Christ Jesus; so that we go receive di promise of di Spirit through faith.
Brothers, I dey talk for human terms. Though na only man covenant, yet when dem don confirm am, nobody dey cancel am or add to am.
Now dem talk di promises to Abraham and to im seed. E no talk, “To seeds,” as of many, but as of one, “To your seed,” wey be Christ.
Now I talk this. Covenant wey God confirm before for Christ, di law, wey come 430 years after, no dey cancel am, so as to make di promise empty.
Because if di inheritance dey of di law, e no dey of promise again; but God don grant am to Abraham by promise.
Wetin den be di law? Dem add am because of transgressions, until di seed go come wey dem make di promise to. Dem order am through angels by di hand of mediator.
Now mediator no be for one, but God na one.
Di law den dey against di promises of God? Never! Because if dem give law wey fit make alive, for sure righteousness go don dey of di law.
But di Scripture lock all things under sin, so that di promise by faith for Jesus Christ go dey given to di people wey believe.
But before faith come, dem keep us for custody under di law, lock us in for di faith wey go dey revealed afterwards.
So di law don become our tutor to bring us to Christ, so that dem go justify us by faith.
But now say faith don come, we no dey under tutor again.
Because una all na God pikin dem, through faith for Christ Jesus.
Because as many of una as dem baptize into Christ don put on Christ.
Jew or Greek no dey, slave or free no dey, male and female no dey; because una all na one for Christ Jesus.
If una be Christ own, den una be Abraham seed and heirs according to promise.
But I talk say as long as di heir be pikin, e no different from bondservant though e be owner of all,
but e dey under guardians and stewards until di day wey im papa appoint.
So we too, when we be pikin dem, dem hold us for bondage under di elements of di world.
But when di fullness of di time come, God send out im Pikin, wey woman born, wey dem born under di law,
so that e go redeem di people wey dey under di law, so that we go receive di adoption of pikin dem.
And because una be pikin dem, God send out di Spirit of im Pikin enter una hearts, dey cry, “Abba! Papa God!”
So una no be bondservant again, but son; and if son, den heir of God through Christ.
However for that time, as una no know God, una dey for bondage to di ones wey by nature no be gods.
But now say una don know God, or rather say God don know una, why una dey turn back again to di weak and miserable elemental principles, wey una want dey for bondage to all over again?
Una dey observe days, months, seasons, and years.
I dey fear for una, say perhaps I don waste my labor for una.
I beg una, brothers, become like me, because I don become like una too. Una no do me any wrong.
But una know say because of weakness of di flesh I preach di Good News to una di first time.
Wetin dey temptation to una for my flesh, una no despise am or reject am; but una receive me as angel of God, as Christ Jesus.
Wia den di blessing wey una enjoy dey? Because I testify to una say, if e possible, una go don pluck out una eyes and give dem to me.
So I don become una enemy by telling una di truth?
Dem dey seek una with zeal for no good way. No, dem want separate una from us, so that una go seek dem.
But e always good to dey zealous for good matter, and no only when I dey with una.
My small pikin dem, wey I dey for labor pain again until Christ form inside una—
but I fit wish to dey with una now, and to change my tone, because I confuse about una.
Tell me, una wey want dey under di law, una no dey listen to di law?
Because e dey write say Abraham get two sons, one by di servant, and one by di free woman.
However, di son by di servant dem born am according to di flesh, but di son by di free woman dem born am through promise.
These things get allegory, because these na two covenants. One na from Mount Sinai, dey bear pikin dem for bondage, wey be Hagar.
Because this Hagar na Mount Sinai for Arabia, and e match di Jerusalem wey dey now, because e dey bondage with im pikin dem.
But di Jerusalem wey dey above free, wey be our mama.
Because e dey write, “Rejoice, you wey no fit born. Break out and shout, you wey no dey labor. Because di desolate get more pikin dem pass di one wey get husband.”
Now we, brothers, as Isaac be, na pikin dem of promise.
But as den, di one wey dem born according to di flesh persecute di one wey dem born according to di Spirit, na so e be now too.
However wetin di Scripture talk? “Throw out di servant and im son, because di servant son no go inherit with di free woman son.”
So den, brothers, we no be pikin dem of servant, but of di free woman.
So stand firm for di freedom wey Christ don use free us, and no entangle again with yoke of bondage.
Look, I, Paul, dey tell una say if una receive circumcision, Christ no go profit una anything.
Yes, I testify again to every man wey receive circumcision, say e na debtor to do di whole law.
Una don separate from Christ, una wey go dey justified by di law. Una don fall away from grace.
Because we, through di Spirit, by faith dey wait for di hope of righteousness.
Because for Christ Jesus circumcision or uncircumcision no dey profit anything, but faith wey dey work through love.
Una dey run well! Who interfere with una say una no go obey di truth?
This persuasion no come from di one wey dey call una.
Small yeast dey spread through di whole lump.
I get confidence towards una for di Lord say una no go think any other way. But di one wey dey trouble una go bear im judgment, whoever e be.
But I, brothers, if I still dey preach circumcision, why dem still dey persecute me? Den di stumbling block of di cross don dey removed.
I wish say di people wey dey disturb una go cut demself off.
Because una, brothers, dem call una for freedom. Only no use una freedom for gain to di flesh, but through love dey serve each other.
Because di whole law dey fulfilled for one word, for this: “You go love your neighbor as yourself.”
But if una dey bite and dey devour each other, take care say una no go consume each other.
But I talk, waka by di Spirit, and una no go fulfill di lust of di flesh.
Because di flesh dey lust against di Spirit, and di Spirit against di flesh; and these dey against each other, so that una no go do di things wey una want.
But if di Spirit dey lead una, una no dey under di law.
Now di works of di flesh clear, wey be: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
envyings, murders, drunkenness, carousing, and things like these; wey I dey warn una about before, even as I warn una before, say di people wey dey practice such things no go inherit God Kingdom.
But di fruit of di Spirit na love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
gentleness, and self-control. Law no dey against such things.
Di people wey belong to Christ don crucify di flesh with im passions and lusts.
If we live by di Spirit, make we waka by di Spirit too.
Make we no become conceited, dey provoke each other, dey envy each other.
Brothers, even if dem catch man for some offense, una wey dey spiritual must restore such person with spirit of gentleness; as you dey look yourself so dem no go tempt you too.
Bear each other burdens, and so fulfill di law of Christ.
Because if man think say e be something when e be nothing, e dey deceive imself.
But make each man test im own work, and den e go get reason to boast for imself alone, and no for somebody else.
Because each man go bear im own burden.
But make di one wey dem teach for di word share all good things with di one wey dey teach.
No dey deceived. Dem no dey mock God, because whatever man plant, na that e go harvest too.
Because di one wey plant to im own flesh go from di flesh harvest corruption. But di one wey plant to di Spirit go from di Spirit harvest life wey no dey end.
Make we no tire to do good, because we go harvest for di right season, if we no give up.
So den, as we get opportunity, make we do wetin good towards all men, and especially towards di people wey dey for di household of di faith.
See wetin large letters I write to una with my own hand.
As many as want look good for di flesh, na dem dey force una to circumcise, only so that dem no go persecute dem for di cross of Christ.
Because even dem wey receive circumcision no dey keep di law demself; but dem want make una circumcise, so that dem go boast for una flesh.
But e far from me to boast, except for di cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which di world don crucify to me, and I to di world.
Because for Christ Jesus circumcision or uncircumcision no mean anything, but new creation.
As many as waka by this rule, peace and mercy dey on dem, and on God Israel.
From now, make nobody cause me trouble, because I carry for my body di marks of di Lord Jesus.
Di grace of our Lord Jesus Christ dey with una spirit, brothers. Amen.
